status_summary: No EIA action matching the firming-cost, reserve-margin, subsidy-report or privatization items was found. EIA's levelized cost paper for the Annual Energy Outlook 2026, released 2026-04-08, uses a value-cost ratio framework and does not mention firming or backup costs or reserve margins. EIA's latest federal subsidies report remains the edition released 2023-08-01, and the FY2027 DOE budget request for EIA seeks $135.37 million and does not mention firming costs, a subsidy report, reserve margins or privatization.
title: EIA to add firming costs to LCOE, revise reserve margins, publish annual subsidy report
uncertainties: Absence of evidence from a limited search. The researcher ran four searches on eia.gov (levelized cost page, subsidy report page), the DOE FY2027 EIA budget volume and news on EIA staffing; the reviewer re-read the eia.gov levelized cost and subsidy report pages. The AEO2026 methodology document was not opened, so a firming adjustment in the methodology cannot be excluded. A reported staff reduction and delayed reports in 2025 are workforce effects and are not treated as matching actions. FY2026 request details and the International Energy Outlook schedule were not read.
